acceptanceCriteria: page chrome, chips, and progress meter match the mock's design language
renders correctly in light and dark at 375/768/1280
uses existing shadcn primitives + theme tokens; no functional regressions

nodes.title: Roster & Order Entry Data Model
nodes.description: Add rosterEntries (name+number player slot on a design) and orderEntries (one jersey: size+qty+submitter+source) as additive schema, plus lib rules/form modules and a one-run-per-order guard. Extends jerseyRuns.status with 'locked'. Load-bearing foundation; old tables stay until R-07.
acceptanceCriteria: rosterEntries + orderEntries tables exist with indexes
status union extended to open
closed
locked; one-run-per-order guard
convex dev clean, smoke + lib unit tests pass

nodes.title: Public Form — Fan Orders Across All Designs
nodes.description: Switch the public run form onto the new model: a fan sees all the order's designs and adds multiple jerseys in one submission, grouped by name/email. Orders attach to existing matching roster slots; open-mode exact matches raise a collision flag.
acceptanceCriteria: form lists all designs; single-design collapses picker
N jerseys -> N order entries grouped by submitter
matching name+number attaches; open-mode match flags collision

nodes.title: Captain Roster Seeding + Not Yet Filled
nodes.description: Let the captain pre-enter name+number roster slots per design (replacing fixedRoster). A slot with zero order entries renders 'not yet filled' and is excluded from the total until a fan order fills it. Captain can see/edit collision flags.
acceptanceCriteria: captain CRUD roster entries with source=captain
zero-order-entry slot reads not-yet-filled
matching fan order flips it to filled

nodes.title: Derived Counts Query
nodes.description: Query the live production count the order page reads: total = sum of order-entry qty, plus per-design subtotals. Not-yet-filled slots contribute zero; blank/bulk lines count by qty; removed-design entries excluded.
acceptanceCriteria: total = sum(qty)
per-design subtotals via group-by designId
not-yet-filled excluded, blanks counted, removed excluded

nodes.title: Relabel / Remove Design on the Roster
nodes.description: Edit-after-collection safety: relabel carries a design's entries over untouched; remove keeps entries visible, flags them 'removed', drops them from the count, and surfaces a warning naming affected submitters. Non-destructive.
acceptanceCriteria: relabel preserves all entries + counts
remove returns affected-submitter list, flags entries
removed entries excluded from R-04 total, no data deleted

nodes.title: Lock & Freeze
nodes.description: The lock that freezes the production basis. Captain/admin can lock manually; a run auto-locks lazily when its deadline passes. Admin can always unlock, captain only pre-deadline. Locked runs reject roster/order/design mutations and freeze a count snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: manual lock sets status + snapshot
past-deadline run reads locked lazily; unlock perms (admin always, captain pre-deadline)
mutations rejected when locked

nodes.title: Migrate Remaining Surfaces + Retire Old Tables
nodes.description: Cleanup slice: migrate admin oversight, run responses page, participation history and response views onto the new model, then delete jerseyRunResponses + jerseyRuns.fixedRoster. Done last so every writer is migrated before the legacy table is dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: all read surfaces use orderEntries/rosterEntries
jerseyRunResponses + fixedRoster removed; no references remain
full suite green, convex dev clean

nodes.title: Fix Broken useSearchParams in IntakeForm
nodes.description: IntakeForm crashes when rendered without a router SearchParamsContext (unit tests, and any static-render edge case) because useInitialQty calls searchParams.get without a null guard, and app/intake/page.tsx never wraps IntakeForm in a Suspense boundary as Next.js requires for useSearchParams consumers. Discovered because it broke npm test for everyone, blocking all DAG completions via the verify.mjs gate.
acceptanceCriteria: useInitialQty guards against a null searchParams return
app/intake/page.tsx wraps IntakeForm in a Suspense boundary
npm test passes (IntakeForm.test.tsx no longer crashes)
no behavior change to the qty prefill feature

nodes.title: Design Assets Metadata Table
nodes.description: Replace designs.fileIds with a designAssets table (filename, contentType, uploader, isMain) plus a shared main-image resolver. Foundation for thumbnails and image/non-image detection.
acceptanceCriteria: designAssets table with per-file metadata, by_design index
Upload persists filename+contentType; queries resolve URLs
Main-image resolver + web-safe predicate + permission helpers, unit-tested

nodes.title: Design Blocks Model and Read Rendering
nodes.description: Add designs.blocks (ordered text|gallery|palette union), remove brief (Overview replaces it), and render blocks read-only on portal + admin pages.
acceptanceCriteria: blocks union persisted with validators (field uniqueness, single palette, swatch shape)
brief removed; Overview is the summary source
Read-only rendering: inline images by content type, cards otherwise, palette swatches

nodes.title: Shared Block Editor: Text Sections and Reorder
nodes.description: Build the shared block editor shell (add/remove/reorder blocks) and ship the fixed text sections through it, wired into the portal.
acceptanceCriteria: DesignBlockEditor shell with add-menu, remove, drag-reorder persisted
Text fields Overview/Concept/Inspiration/Notes, each once, Overview required
Owner-or-admin guarded block mutations re-run validators

nodes.title: Palette Block Editor
nodes.description: Add palette editing to the shared editor: one palette per design, unlimited swatches with hex picker, role (primary/secondary/accent), label, and free-text Pantone code.
acceptanceCriteria: At most one palette block; second prevented
Swatch add/remove/reorder with hex, role, label, Pantone text
Hex via on-screen picker; renders light+dark

nodes.title: Gallery Blocks and Asset Pool
nodes.description: Manage the uploaded image pool (upload, set-main, delete under permission rules) and build captioned galleries from hand-picked images. Heaviest slice.
acceptanceCriteria: Asset pool: upload, set-main, delete with permission matrix
Gallery blocks: caption + hand-picked assetIds, multiple per design
Deleting a referenced asset leaves galleries valid

nodes.title: Admin Design Page Uses Shared Editor
nodes.description: Mount the shared block editor on the admin design page, replacing InlineEditField for design content, so admin and owner edit through one code path.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin page renders shared DesignBlockEditor
InlineEditField removed for design content
Admin upload + admin-delete-only enforced; owner/admin produce same state

nodes.title: Order Page Design Main Image
nodes.description: Show each linked design's resolved main image next to its file count on the order page. Thin read-side + UI slice over the D-01 resolver.
acceptanceCriteria: Order query returns per-design main image URL + file count
Order page renders thumbnail beside count with no-image fallback
Handles unavailable URLs gracefully

nodes.title: Design Page Motion and Polish
nodes.description: Deferred polish pass: tasteful motion, hover, transitions across the design page + editor. Starts with a human design discussion before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Human design direction agreed first (needs-human)
Motion/hover/transition polish applied; respects reduced-motion
No functional regressions

nodes.title: Wipe Stale Dev Design and Capture Track D Screenshots
nodes.description: One pre-D-01 design blocks the schema push, so snap.mjs has no backend: D-01/D-02/D-03 all shipped without screenshots. Wipe it, push, re-snap all three.

snap.mjs captures /portal/designs/[id] and /admin/designs/[id] for D-01, D-02 and D-03
Obvious visual breakage found in those screenshots fixed or filed
docs/review/<nodeId>/ populated at 375/768/1280 light+dark
